classification.difficultyReason: Reverse the profit or loss percentage to recover costs, then choose addition for profit and subtraction for loss to obtain sales.

content.prompt: Give answers to the nearest dollar.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A company made a profit of $\$28\,000$, which was a $5.4\%$ profit on its costs. Find the costs and the total sales.

answer.short:
Costs: $\$518\,519$; total sales: $\$546\,519$.

Divide the profit by $0.054$ to recover costs, then add the profit.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Profit}&=\text{costs}\times0.054\\\text{Costs}&=28\,000\div0.054\\\text{Costs}&=\frac{14\,000\,000}{27}\\\text{Costs}&\approx\$518\,519\\\text{Total sales}&=\text{costs}+\text{profit}\\\text{Total sales}&=\frac{14\,000\,000}{27}+28\,000\\\text{Total sales}&\approx\$546\,519\end{align*}$$
Both amounts are rounded to the nearest dollar.

children.label: b
children.prompt: A company made a loss of $\$750\,000$, which was a $6.5\%$ loss on its costs. Find the costs and the total sales.

answer.short:
Costs: $\$11\,538\,462$; total sales: $\$10\,788\,462$.

Divide the loss by $0.065$ to recover costs, then subtract the loss.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Loss}&=\text{costs}\times0.065\\\text{Costs}&=750\,000\div0.065\\\text{Costs}&=\frac{150\,000\,000}{13}\\\text{Costs}&\approx\$11\,538\,462\\\text{Total sales}&=\text{costs}-\text{loss}\\\text{Total sales}&=\frac{150\,000\,000}{13}-750\,000\\\text{Total sales}&\approx\$10\,788\,462\end{align*}$$
Both amounts are rounded to the nearest dollar.
